$comment: Every key is optional; an omitted key takes its default. Keys starting with
$ are ignored by the loader and exist only as notes.
There are no provider presets. Fill in baseUrl + path + model for YOUR
deployment. Known values, as of September 2026 (see README for the table):
local relay           your host                 your path            your model
Set 'endpoint' instead of baseUrl+path when the path is unusual.
'apiKey' accepts a literal, or ${NAME} to read an environment variable.
Braces are required; a bare $NAME is sent literally, exactly as written.
The rules the model judges against are NOT in this file. They live in
policy.md next to it, created from a minimal default on first run. Edit it
there; it supports ${NAME} environment expansion too.
